title: He pulled the halldoor to after him very quietly, more, till the footleaf dropped gently over the threshold, a limp lid. Looked shut. All right till I come back anyhow.
html_source: The original door from 7 Eccles Street was moved and is now on display at the James Joyce Centre in Dublin.
